job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Actions (Auth0)
job.location: Bellevue, WA; Chicago, IL; New York, NY; Washington, DC
job.pay_full: $152,000 – $209,000 a year base salary (for candidates in California excluding the SF Bay Area, Colorado, Illinois, New York and Washington), plus equity where applicable, bonus and benefits

details.about: Okta builds identity infrastructure that secures both people and AI. This role joins the Extensibility Engineering team in Developer Experience – Extensibility Platform, which runs Auth0's ultra-low-latency, secure and scalable platform for executing untrusted code, a foundation of Auth0's ecosystem for customers and partners.
duties: Design, architect and document large-scale distributed systems
Build features across the stack with Go, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes
Lead team discussions and mentor engineers toward senior level
Improve Auth0's architecture, performance, observability, security controls and best practices
Work with Product and Security teams to define and improve the Extensibility platform
Take part in on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues
needs: 5+ years of software development building distributed systems in Go and Node/TypeScript
Strong experience with API-driven applications using REST and/or gRPC
Experience packaging and distributing containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes
A high bar for code quality and user experience
Proven ability to collaborate and drive initiatives forward
nice: Experience sandboxing untrusted code or with tenant isolation
details.benefits: Base salary $152,000 – $209,000 a year for candidates in California (excluding the San Francisco Bay Area), Colorado, Illinois, New York and Washington; actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience and location. Okta also offers equity (where applicable), bonus and benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), a flexible spending account and paid leave (including PTO and parental leave).
notes: New hires start with an in-person onboarding experience
Okta may use automated employment decision tools in hiring for New York City applicants (see the posting's notice)
